name: FastMCP
what: A Python framework for building MCP servers, clients and interactive apps. You write ordinary Python functions and FastMCP generates the tool schemas, validation and docs. FastMCP 1.0 was folded into the official MCP Python SDK in 2024; this is the actively maintained standalone project. Apache-2.0.
who: Python developers who want to turn their own functions or APIs into an MCP server quickly.

setup.text: Add it to your project with uv:
Run it with python server.py, then add it to your MCP client. A TypeScript counterpart is available as @prefecthq/fastmcp-ts.

prompts: Turn the functions in utils/weather.py into a FastMCP server with one tool each.
Add a FastMCP resource that exposes our README as context.
Write a FastMCP client script that connects to my server and lists its tools.
